title: Graph convolutional network predicts ACE-inhibitory peptides; two synthesized hits active
summary: Peptides of 2-10 amino acids were represented as molecular graphs and a graph convolutional network was built to predict ACE inhibitory potential. It outperformed random forest, SVM and kNN descriptor models (accuracy 0.78) and exceeded existing methods with over 98% accuracy on an independent test set. Two predicted peptides, VAPE and AQQKEP, were synthesized and showed ACE inhibition with IC50 values of 2.25 +/- 0.11 and 3.75 +/- 0.17 uM; only two peptides were tested.
ai_technology: Graph convolutional network on molecular graphs of variable-length peptides
